svg.title: H04 STARDUST CARBON ATLAS engineering architecture
svg.desc: The diagram binds target identity, preparation and spatial registration to calibrated count inference. It distinguishes isotope heterogeneity from phase-carrier and origin claims, with unavailable TAM19B-7 records retained as explicit gaps.
